text.bootstrap_desc: This is a fresh deployment and no administrator account exists yet. Please run the following command on the server to create the first administrator, then refresh this page.
text.bootstrap_hint: Interactive password entry (≥8 characters). Username [a-zA-Z0-9_.-], must not start with apikey:.
text.invite_hint: Invitation code is issued by the administrator. Don't have one? Contact the administrator to get it.
text.login_failed: Login failed, please check your username or password.
text.register_failed: Registration failed, please check your invitation code and form fields.

error.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: Invalid username or password, please try again.
error.USER_DISABLED: This account has been disabled by the administrator, please contact the system administrator.
error.NO_IDP: Login service is not ready, please try again later or contact the administrator.
error.INVALID_USERNAME: Invalid username format: must be 3-64 characters, only [a-zA-Z0-9_.-], and cannot start with apikey:.
error.INVALID_PASSWORD: Invalid password length: must be 8-72 characters.
error.USERNAME_TAKEN: This username is already taken. If you just registered with this invitation code, the code has been consumed, please contact the administrator to re-issue and try again with another name.
error.INVITATION_NOT_FOUND: Invitation code does not exist, please check and try again.
error.INVITATION_USED: Invitation code has already been used (once per code). Please contact the administrator to re-issue.
error.INVITATION_EXPIRED: Invitation code has expired. Please contact the administrator to re-issue.
error.STATE_EXPIRED: Login status has expired, please log in again.
error.CSRF_DETECTED: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) detected, please ensure cookies are enabled in your browser and try again.
error.STATE_INVALID: Invalid login state, please log in again.
error.USER_CREATE_FAILED: Failed to create user account from SSO.
error.CODE_EXCHANGE_FAILED: Failed to exchange SSO authorization code.
error.IDP_ERROR: Third-party identity provider returned an error.
error.UNAUTHORIZED: Session unauthorized, please log in first.
error.BAD_REQUEST: Request parameters missing, please complete the form and try again.
error.default: Operation failed ({{code}}), please try again or contact the administrator.

onboarding.subtitle: Get started with your first conversation in a few steps
onboarding.step1: 1. Create your first workspace (working directory) in settings
onboarding.step2: 2. Choose a worker type (claude_code / codex, etc.)
onboarding.step3: 3. Enter tasks in the dialog and start coding
